'''Poln Major''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]]. Poln Major was the seat of government in the area.
